story_type: capsule dropped from a cargo jet with parachutes rigged to fail
hook: NASA rigged this capsule's parachutes to fail, then dropped it.
narration: NASA pulled this capsule out of a cargo jet with its parachutes rigged to fail.
May first, twenty thirteen. A C-17 carried a test version of Orion twenty five thousand feet above the Arizona desert near Yuma.
Engineers set one of its two drogue chutes not to open, and one of its three main chutes to skip its first stage of inflation.
Drogues slow and steady a falling capsule first, so the big main chutes can open without tearing.
The capsule was doing about two hundred fifty miles an hour when its parachutes deployed.
outcome: Even with both failures, the test capsule landed safely in the desert.
title: Capsule dropped with chutes set to fail
description:
On May 1, 2013, NASA dropped a test version of its Orion spacecraft from a C-17 over the Arizona desert near Yuma with two parachute failures built in, and the capsule landed safely.
